scenario.title: Test 7: Loan Amount > ₹75 Lakh with Counter-Offer Acceptance
dialogue: I need 90 lakhs for my business expansion.
Yes, that's fine, I can proceed with the maximum 75 lakhs.
Self-employed business owner, bank account receipts.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Hello Rajesh Singhania, good day! I am Priya calling from Home Credit. Am I speaking with Rajesh Singhania?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: Yes, Rajesh speaking.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Great! Do you have a couple of minutes to speak right now?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: Yes, go ahead.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Thank you. To check your eligibility, could you please tell me what type of property you own—is it residential, commercial, or industrial?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: Commercial showroom.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Got that. Is this property in your sole ownership, or is it jointly owned with someone else?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: Sole ownership.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Thank you. Do you have the original property documents available for physical verification?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: Yes, originals are available.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Understood. What is the approximate loan amount you are looking to borrow?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: I need 90 lakhs for my business expansion.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: The current pre-approved offer is available for up to a maximum limit of ₹75 lakhs. Would you like to proceed with the maximum eligible amount of ₹75 lakhs?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: Yes, that's fine, I can proceed with the maximum 75 lakhs.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Got it. Is your monthly income credited directly to your bank account, or is it received in cash?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: Self-employed business owner, bank account receipts.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Approximately what is the current market value of your property?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: Valuation is about 2.5 crore.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: What repayment tenure would you prefer for this loan, between 3 to 15 years?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: Tenure of 12 years.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Congratulations Rajesh Singhania! Based on the preliminary details provided, you meet all the eligibility criteria for our pre-approved Loan Against Property offer. I am now transferring your application to our Senior Loan Expert, who will contact you shortly to share the exact interest rates, customized EMI plans, and assist you with the fast-track paperwork. Thank you for choosing Home Credit, and have a wonderful day!
